test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following union territories celebrates Tarpa festival?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Dadra and Nagar Haveli.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Tarpa Festival in **Dadra**, the winter festival of India.
 
• Tarpa Festival gets its name from the famous and extremely popular folk dance of Dadra & Nagar Haveli- the **Tarpa Dance.**
 
• The many kinds of folk and tribal dances of Dadra and Nagar Haveli include the **Tarpa Dance, Bhawada Dance, Dhol Dance, and Tur and Thali Dance**.
 
• Tarpa is **the most popular and colourful folk dance among the Varli, Kokna, and Koli tribes**, and is best seen in Silvassa.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61ccc300d5967bacc193759ac0aa29e9ee299893331cb0816582bb3702c61dab.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shondol dance**, which is called the **royal dance of Ladakh**, has generated history by entering into the **Guinness Book of World Records as the largest Ladakhi dance.****​ **
 
• **Nicobari dance** is the traditional dance of Andaman and Nicobar.
 
• **Kolkali and Parichakali** are the two popular folk art forms in the Territory **Lakshadweep.**
